svg.title: Booking and List update process
svg.text: St George's and Southern Cross send
their theatre Lists, a day ahead.
Rows arrive on their own; nobody
Emailed PDF Lists, read from the
Adds a missing Booking in the
app; photo capture is future work.
Every source in one feed, grouped
by List: a hospital file is a heading
over its Lists, a PDF is one List.
The system finds the List with
then its Bookings by NHI. The
admin sees each key ticked, the
Or the admin searches by hand.
The admin chooses where it goes:
Rows with no NHI get a stub on the List.
One row per Booking. Untick a change to leave it out.

g.text: a removal to confirm as a cancellation

svg.text: Lists that match exactly are confirmed together in one click.
Rows that can't be placed stay in the feed: nothing is dropped.
The Sources view shows each source's state and anything held.
Later: routine updates applied automatically; odd ones still go to an admin.
The List as the admin placed it,
with its Bookings and any stubs:
in a free Slot, on an existing List,
the same rule as staff edits.
